title: Tum Meri Baat Sun Rahe Ho
visual_system: single continuous 4-seater dinner-table scene with same wardrobe across all slides

slides.story_job: Set up a peaceful dinner-table moment before the trap begins.
slides.camera_angle: corner or doorway view of the 4-seater table
slides.primary_action: Aachu and Zuv sit opposite each other mid-conversation; table props make the scene feel ordinary and peaceful.

slides.text:
She asks,
“tum meri baat sun rahe ho?”
slides.story_job: Aachu notices the tiny absence and tests it.
slides.primary_action: Aachu leans slightly across the table with one hand mid-gesture; Zuv nods casually.

slides.story_job: Show Zuv's fake confidence and the proof that he is on autopilot.
slides.camera_angle: three-quarter table view from Aachu's side
slides.who_is_visible: Zuv foreground, Aachu across or partial
slides.primary_action: Zuv nods too confidently while his phone sits near or in his hand, proving the distraction.

slides.camera_angle: straight across the table, both faces and hands readable
slides.primary_action: Aachu leans in with one eyebrow raised; Zuv's smile is about to vanish and the phone becomes a liability.

slides.text:
And suddenly,
my entire life flashes before my eyes.
slides.story_job: Payoff: Zuv freezes in survival mode while Aachu waits.
slides.camera_angle: slight side angle across the table
slides.primary_action: Zuv freezes with phone paused mid-action, eyes widened and mouth slightly open; Aachu waits calmly across the table.

slides.text:
But still, every day,
we choose this nonsense.
slides.story_job: Melt panic into warmth and shared ritual.
slides.primary_action: Aachu is amused now; Zuv gives a sheepish smile, phone face-down beside his plate.

slides.text:
Because love is not always peaceful.
Sometimes love is just getting caught beautifully.
slides.story_job: End with playful affection inside the same table scene.
slides.primary_action: Aachu lightly flicks/taps Zuv with a folded napkin while smiling; Zuv grins and lifts a hand in surrender.
